name: idle-guard
description: Compacts the main conversation after 54 idle minutes so a late wake rewrites a summary, not the whole context.

minutes.title: Idle minutes
minutes.description: Idle minutes before compacting; 30 s are added so the built-in idle compaction goes first.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minTokens.description: Compact only when the live context holds at least this many tokens.
